title: Venom
full_review:
"Venom" (Miramax) is a brainless and bloody voodoo-themed B-horror movie set in a backwater Louisiana town where a crowbar-wielding truck driver's (Rick Cramer) corpse becomes infested with evil spirits through black magic gone awry and, once reanimated, terrorizes a group of teenagers (including Agnes Bruckner and Bijou Phillips).

High on body count and cliches and low on suspense, director Jim Gillespie's bayou blunder is little else than a series of shock-value slayings strung together by a silly supernatural plot.

The film contains much graphic and gory violence, including impalings and dismemberment, occult mumbo jumbo, brief sexual suggestiveness, recurring rough and crude language and profanity. The USCCB Office for Film & Broadcasting classification is O -- morally offensive. The Motion Picture Association of America rating is R -- restricted.
